subject.title: fix(auth): bound auth-profile source JSON probe reads

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally treat valid persisted auth-profile JSON above 1 MiB as absent in provider-source routing and diagnostic probes?
rationale: The code is mechanically small, but the cutoff changes behavior for existing persisted credentials and requires an owner decision on the supported auth-store contract versus a more compatible bounded inspection design.

options.title: Preserve large-store eligibility
options.body: Use a bounded or incremental eligibility strategy that hardens reads without making valid existing stores disappear from provider-source detection.

options.title: Adopt the 1 MiB contract
options.body: Keep the cutoff only after documenting the supported maximum and supplying an explicit migration or operator recovery path for oversized existing stores.

recommendation.title: Preserve large-store eligibility
recommendation.body: Use a bounded or incremental eligibility strategy that hardens reads without making valid existing stores disappear from provider-source detection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the adjacent bounded-file-read pattern makes them the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
